name: Blaise Pascal Quantum Challenge 2025
description: The Blaise Pascal Quantum Challenge 2025 invited global innovators to explore how quantum-powered AI can support the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Organized by Pasqal, the challenge attracted 137 submissions from teams worldwide, with the top 15 advancing to a two-week virtual hackathon. The winning team received EUR 15,000 from a total prize pool of EUR 30,000.
eligibility: Open to global innovators and teams

news.title: The Blaise Pascal Quantum Challenge 2025 - Highlights & Winners
news.excerpt: Pasqal's quantum AI challenge attracted 850+ applicants from 70+ nationalities with 137 proposals submitted. The top 15 finalist teams were selected to compete in a hackathon blending quantum computing and artificial intelligence to address UN Sustainable Development Goals.
